description: (Na)₂AgSbCl₆ is alpha Rhenium trioxide-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a AgSbCl₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the AgSbCl₆ framework, Ag is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form AgCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SbCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Ag-Cl bond lengths are 2.68 Å. Sb is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form SbCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent AgCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Sb-Cl bond lengths are 2.65 Å. Cl is bonded in a linear geometry to one Ag and one Sb atom.
